metrics: rank site-level paired heldout log score differences (beta minus constant) descending
sum of positive and negative site contributions separately
share of net gain from top 1,3,5,10 sites; shares may exceed 100% if negative offsets
remove top 1,3,5,10 positive-contribution sites and report residual total, mean and win counts
paired 5% and 10% symmetric trimmed site-delta mean
median site delta and number beta wins
fold-level gains, all five fixed folds
interpretation: A positive total heldout log score can be dominated by a few hard-to-predict sites even if individual-site wins are nearly balanced. Report all diagnostics without cherry-picking.
scope: Same dataset and original CV, no new independent external validation, no measured A/B/M or EOG-WF endpoint.
